name: Integra Design Intelligence Library

primarySources: Impeccable (primary design methodology and critique reference; original Integra synthesis)
secondarySources: Official design systems and platform documentation
Asset, font, color and motion providers

policy: Presets and token recipes are contextual starting points, never universal templates. Preserve user intent, existing project identity, actual product behavior, accessibility, evidence status and provenance. Extract principles rather than reproducing complete reference pages, code or assets.

evidencePolicy.verifiedRequires: Inspection of a specific page or section with date, evidence type, observed state/viewport and limitations.
evidencePolicy.assetRights: Per-asset source, creator, licence/version, attribution and restriction checks are required before production use.
evidencePolicy.tokenContrast: Recipes require actual rendered contrast verification; no starter recipe claims conformance.
evidencePolicy.rules: Heuristic unless explicitly linked to an applicable normative criterion; never a defect without observation and impact.
